title: axis_ratings
description: The 0-10 axis ratings for one posting (llm.rate_axes). These are the fuzzy sub-scores; the deterministic geometric-mean scoring lives in the skeleton, NOT here. Each axis has a rubric in the rate_axes prompt. barrier_to_entry is an INVERSE axis (10 = very hard to enter); the skeleton inverts it into accessibility.

visualization.description: How central is visual/rendering/aesthetic craft? 10 = rendering/visual output is the job; 0 = no visual component.

spatial_relevance.description: 10 = core spatial/VMD/exhibition/architectural work; 0 = no physical-space component.

cs_usefulness.description: How useful is computer-science / programming ability? 10 = scripting/tools/shaders central; 0 = none needed.

english_usefulness.description: How much does English help? 10 = global/English-first team or docs; 0 = Korean-only, English irrelevant.

freelance_potential.description: How viable is this as freelance/contract work? 10 = commonly freelanced; 0 = only in-house/salaried.

market_demand.description: How much hiring demand does this field show? 10 = abundant openings; 0 = almost none.

barrier_to_entry.description: INVERSE axis. 10 = very hard to break into (senior-only, rare skills, heavy portfolio); 0 = very accessible to a career switcher. The skeleton computes accessibility = 1 - barrier/10.
